task_completion.description: Log in to the OpenSIS application using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the OpenSIS login page followed by the dashboard after entering 'admin' and 'Admin@123'.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the scheduling or course section of OpenSIS to find 'Algebra I'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking on 'Scheduling' or 'Courses' in the sidebar or top menu.
The VLM should see 'Algebra I' highlighted or selected in the course list or search results.

task_completion.description: Access the roster report generation tool for the selected course.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a 'Print Roster', 'Class Roster', or 'Reports' button being clicked within the context of the Algebra I course.

task_completion.description: Generate the PDF version of the roster within the browser/application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A PDF preview or a print dialog showing a roster with students 'John Smith' and 'Jane Doe' should be visible.

task_completion.description: Save the generated PDF to the specific path /home/ga/Documents/algebra_roster.pdf.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a 'Save As' dialog with the file path '/home/ga/Documents/algebra_roster.pdf' typed in, or a file manager view showing the file in that location.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenSIS web interface rather than manually creating a PDF via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see mouse movements and clicks within the OpenSIS GUI, not just a series of 'touch' or 'pdfgen' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The roster contains the specific students injected into the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final PDF or preview must explicitly show the names 'John Smith' and 'Jane Doe'.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create an empty file or a text file and rename it to .pdf.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the PDF export/print workflow from the browser, not a 'Right Click > New Document' action in the file manager.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected course is 'Algebra I' (Section 1). The roster must contain exactly two students: 'John Smith' and 'Jane Doe'. The final file must be saved to '/home/ga/Documents/algebra_roster.pdf'. Credentials for OpenSIS are admin/Admin@123.
